title: Fleet Tracking System Incident Response
description: Fleet tracking system incidents affecting logistics operations
immediate_actions: Assess impact on fleet operations and logistics coordination
Implement manual fleet tracking procedures if needed
Activate customer service team for shipment inquiries
investigation_steps: Review fleet tracking system logs and status
Check GPS service connectivity and performance
Verify network connectivity to tracking devices
resolution_steps: Restart fleet tracking services following standard procedures
Implement GPS service fixes if needed
Apply tracking system patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with GPS service provider for complex issues
verification: Confirm with logistics staff that system is operational
special_considerations: Fleet tracking is critical for logistics coordination
Manual tracking procedures may impact operational efficiency
Maintain communication with drivers during system restoration
Document any tracking interruptions that may affect shipments
